name: Add evidence review status summary
description: Add a compact status summary to the evidence review workflow so a developer can immediately see how many required acceptance criteria are passing, failing, unreviewed, or missing evidence.
behavior: When the evidence review workflow is open, the UI shows a status summary derived from the current criterion review state, and that summary updates when a criterion verdict or selected evidence changes.
steps: Review the status summary before changing any criteria.
Mark a required criterion pass and choose evidence.
Confirm the summary reflects the updated criterion state.

name: Add evidence review blocker callout
description: Add a visible blocker callout to the evidence review workflow that lists the concrete reasons the current review cannot be accepted.
behavior: When the evidence review workflow is blocked or rejected, the UI lists the current verdict reasons in a stable, testable callout; when the review becomes accepted, the callout changes to an accepted-state message.
steps: Confirm blocked or rejected verdict reasons are visible.
Complete the required review criteria with passing verdicts and selected evidence.
Confirm the callout changes to the accepted-state message.
